//go:build integration
// +build integration

package integration

import (
	"net/url"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5"
)

func isAllowedLoopbackTestHost(host string) bool {
	host = strings.Trim(strings.TrimSpace(host), "[]")
	return strings.EqualFold(host, "127.0.0.1") || strings.EqualFold(host, "localhost") || strings.EqualFold(host, "::1")
}

func isLoopbackPostgresTestURL(databaseURL string) bool {
	config, err := pgx.ParseConfig(databaseURL)
	return err == nil && isAllowedLoopbackTestHost(config.Host)
}

func isLoopbackNATSTestURL(serverURL string) bool {
	parsed, err := url.Parse(serverURL)
	if err != nil || parsed.Host == "" || strings.Contains(parsed.Host, ",") {
		return false
	}
	return isAllowedLoopbackTestHost(parsed.Hostname())
}

func TestPostgresIntegrationURLRequiresExplicitLoopbackHost(t *testing.T) {
	for _, host := range []string{"127.0.0.1", "localhost", "[::1]"} {
		t.Run("allow_"+strings.NewReplacer(".", "_", ":", "_", "[", "", "]", "").Replace(host), func(t *testing.T) {
			url := "postgres://test:test@" + host + ":5432/student_migration_test?sslmode=disable"
			if !isLoopbackPostgresTestURL(url) {
				t.Fatalf("loopback PostgreSQL URL was rejected: host %s", host)
			}
		})
	}
	for _, host := range []string{"student-db", "127.0.0.2", "localhost.example", ""} {
		t.Run("reject_"+strings.NewReplacer(".", "_", ":", "_", "[", "", "]", "").Replace(host), func(t *testing.T) {
			url := "postgres://test:test@" + host + ":5432/student_migration_test?sslmode=disable"
			if isLoopbackPostgresTestURL(url) {
				t.Fatalf("non-loopback PostgreSQL URL was accepted: host %q", host)
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestNATSIntegrationURLRequiresExplicitLoopbackHost(t *testing.T) {
	for _, host := range []string{"127.0.0.1", "localhost", "[::1]"} {
		t.Run("allow_"+strings.NewReplacer(".", "_", ":", "_", "[", "", "]", "").Replace(host), func(t *testing.T) {
			if !isLoopbackNATSTestURL("nats://" + host + ":4222") {
				t.Fatalf("loopback NATS URL was rejected: host %s", host)
			}
		})
	}
	for _, serverURL := range []string{
		"nats://student-nats:4222",
		"nats://127.0.0.2:4222",
		"nats://localhost.example:4222",
		"nats://127.0.0.1:4222,nats://remote.example:4222",
		"not-a-url",
	} {
		t.Run("reject_"+strings.NewReplacer(".", "_", ":", "_", "/", "_", ",", "_", "[", "", "]", "").Replace(serverURL), func(t *testing.T) {
			if isLoopbackNATSTestURL(serverURL) {
				t.Fatalf("non-loopback NATS URL was accepted: %q", serverURL)
			}
		})
	}
}
